Official pages provide customer support channels and a service-manager lookup using account number or circuit ID. These establish support and account-management routes, not by themselves a complete installation/fulfilment lifecycle.

iManage documents checking the status of new links and service requests. The reviewed FAQ does not establish customer-visible installation milestones, partner assignment, field-progress notes or hold/resume accountability.
